NOTE
**Still not ready — API design discussion has no outcome yet, and the API changelog entry and feature level are missing**

New: The author added a rendered API docs screenshot to the description and says they started a topic in #api design. There is no new push. Missing: agreement on the API design in that discussion, and the API changelog entry and feature level bump, since the changed files include no changelog or version file.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and leave the PR unassigned until the #api design discussion reaches a conclusion.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for adding the screenshot and starting the #api design topic. Please wait for that discussion to settle, then add the API changelog entry and feature level bump described in the [API design guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/processes/api-design.html), and push the update.
```
